entities.summary: Thomas Mark "Tommy, The Bomber" Williams was an American professional ice hockey player. A good skater and shooter, he received his nickname due to an incident in the early 1970s when he joked with Toronto customs officials that his bag contained a bomb. During most of the 1960s, Williams was the only regular American player in the NHL.
